 Post Malone Announces Asia Tour Dates with Don Toliver 
 Home » Post Malone Announces Asia Tour Dates with Don Toliver  
 By Victoria Drum 
 7 months ago 
 Post Malone has announced a new Asia leg of his “BIG ASS Stadium Tour,” with Don Toliver set to appear as a special guest on all dates. 
 The run will begin September 16 at Kai Tak Stadium in Hong Kong. From there, the tour will travel across eight cities, including Kaohsiung’s National Stadium and Rajamangala National Stadium in Bangkok. Additional stops are scheduled at Singapore National Stadium, TM Stadium Nasional in Kuala Lumpur, Philippine Arena in Manila, and Goyang Stadium in Seoul. The Asia leg is set to wrap up on October 6 at K-Arena Yokohama in Tokyo.

 Notably, Malone is getting ready to launch “THE BIG ASS Stadium Tour Part 2” with Jelly Roll. The 25-date summer run across the Unites States is slated to kick off on May 13 in El Paso at Sun Bowl Stadium.  
 From there, the singers are set to make stops in cities such as Baton Rouge, Tampa, Panama City Beach, Charlotte, Toronto, Kansas City and Missoula before wrapping up on July 28 in Salt Lake City at Rice-Eccles Stadium. Carter Faith will join the tour as a special guest on all headlining dates.   
 | RELATED:  Post Malone, Jelly Roll to Headline Boots In The Park 2026 in Albuquerque  |    
 In addition to touring, Malone is also scheduled to appear at several major festivals such as Tortuga Music Festival on April 10 in Fort Lauderdale, followed by a performance at Stagecoach on April 26 in California. Additional festival appearances include Boots In The Park, Gulf Coast Jam, Carolina Country Fest, Barefoot Country Music Festival and Milwaukee’s Summerfest, among others.  
 For more information and additional details, fans can visit Malone’s official website .
